FIELDS.NAME: Crafty Corner Creations
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Crafty Corner Creations operates as a retail store specializing in hobby and craft supplies, catering to a wide array of creative projects, including scrapbooking, knitting, painting, and model building. Our store is dedicated to providing high-quality products sourced from reputable vendors, ensuring the safety and satisfaction of our customers. We prioritize a clean and well-maintained shopping environment with clear aisles and adequate lighting to minimize any risk of accidents. All our operations adhere strictly to local fire and safety codes. We also offer instructional classes and workshops designed to enhance customer skills, fully covered by professional liability insurance to mitigate any potential risks associated with these activities. Our commitment to safety extends to employee training in the handling of tools and materials, ensuring a secure and pleasant shopping experience for everyone.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: "Artisan Gifts LLC, a small business specializing in handmade crafts and custom gift items, located at 456 Artisan Way, Hobbytown, CA 90210-5678."
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a small water leak from a broken pipe resulted in damage to a portion of the inventory, specifically crafting papers and fabrics. The estimated loss was $1,200.00. The issue was promptly addressed, and the damaged inventory was removed. No ongoing claims or disputes are present.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday - Saturday: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Sunday: 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade A, Locked Storage for Non-Hazardous Merchandise
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and alarm system in place to monitor premises.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Crafty Corner Creations does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in its operations. The store specializes in non-hazardous craft supplies and adheres to all local safety regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Crafty Corner Creations sponsors local athletic teams as part of our community engagement initiatives to support youth sports and promote healthy activities.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The store management is responsible for checking and verifying these certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Crafty Corner Creations has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other related crime in connection with this or any other property. Our operations maintain a strong commitment to ethical practices and compliance with all regulations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Crafty Corner Creations has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. All previous insurance relationships have been stable and compliant.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Crafty Corner Creations does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our staff is directly employed and trained in-house to maintain quality service and safety standards.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Crafty Corner Creations carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance and protect both the business and employees in case of workplace injuries. The policy serves as a critical component of our risk management strategy.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Crafty Corner Creations also operates Artisan Gifts LLC, which specializes in handmade crafts and custom gift items. Both businesses are committed to high-quality products and maintaining safe environments for customers.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Crafty Corner Creations does not have any other insurance policies with this company at the moment. The only current policy is CP-2023-ACR-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Crafty Corner Creations is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The store focuses solely on the retail of hobby and craft supplies sourced from reputable vendors.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Crafty Corner Creations does not rent or loan equipment to others. The store focuses on selling craft supplies and providing instructional classes without offering equipment rentals.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Crafty Corner Creations has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a stable financial position.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Crafty Corner Creations does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on non-hazardous craft supplies. We adhere to all safety regulations to ensure a secure shopping environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Crafty Corner Creations does not have any catastrophe exposure, as it specializes in non-hazardous craft supplies and adheres to strict safety and operational standards.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Crafty Corner Creations has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize ethical practices and compliance to maintain a safe and inclusive environment for all.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Crafty Corner Creations has no uncorrected fire code violations and adheres to all local fire and safety regulations. The premises are regularly inspected to maintain compliance.
